description:
Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported.

 We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes.

 We are looking for talented individuals who are motivated by the opportunity to have an outsized impact on not just their company, but the healthcare industry at large.

 What you’ll do

 
 Design, build, and scale software systems to support our rapidly growing product and customer base. This is a generalist role with opportunities to contribute on both the backend and frontend. Depending on the team, this role may focus more heavily on particular parts of the stack with the ability to specialize - let us know what excites you!

 Use AI and LLMs to accelerate your impact and power innovative product features.

 Own projects end-to-end by collaborating closely with the Product, Design, and Client Solutions teams, including scoping, design, implementation, and rollout.

 Work with fellow engineers to raise the bar on our internal Engineering systems and processes, including testing, deployment, observability, and agentic coding.

 Participate in on-call rotations to support production systems.

 
 Qualifications

 
 B.S. or higher in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent industry experience

 3+ years of professional software engineering experience

 Experience with modern programming languages, such as TypeScript, Python, Golang, etc.

 Experience developing software for cloud environments

 Product-engineering mindset: able to balance technical quality with velocity and user value

 Inspired by our mission to improve healthcare through technology

 Self-starter with a strong desire to learn and grow

 
 Bonus Points

 
 Experience with TypeScript, NodeJS, React, GraphQL, AWS, PostgreSQL, or Terraform

 Experience building software in the health-tech or healthcare space

 Experience at early stage software companies

 Leverages agentic coding tools to accelerate time-to-value

 Built and operated LLM-powered products and systems

 
 Benefits 

 
 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)

 401(k) with employer funded match

 Unlimited Vacation

 Commuter Benefits

 Paid parental leave

 Catered lunch on Fridays

 Wellness stipend

 Great Place to Work Certified

 
 The annual salary range for the target level for this role is $130,000 - $160,000 + equity + benefits, including medical, dental, and vision.
 Courier Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

 We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
